engine_options.label: Agent runtime configuration (JSON)
engine_options.help: Native runtime JSON, separate from the gateway's model settings. The runtime defines the inner options; platform-managed keys cannot be overridden. {} supplies an empty object; leave the editor blank to remove this block.

artifacts_enabled.label: Artifacts
artifacts_enabled.help: Let this Agent's conversations publish pages, documents, and diagrams with the built-in artifacts tools. When off, its conversations cannot use those tools; artifacts already published stay available.

skills.label: Custom Skills
skills.help: JSON array of Git strings or source objects, combined with Skills from {{catalog}}. Identical sources are deduplicated; installed names must be unique.
skills.help_alone: JSON array of Git strings or source objects. A source object names provider, source, version and name; config holds public settings and approved credential names.

mcp_servers.label: Custom MCP
mcp_servers.help: Enter server definitions to combine with the servers selected from {{catalog}}; server names must be unique
mcp_servers.help_alone: Enter server definitions; server names must be unique

terminal_panel.label: Terminal panel
terminal_panel.help: Show the terminal in this Agent's conversations. Hiding it does not restrict command execution or API access.

diff_panel.label: Diff panel
diff_panel.help: Show file changes in this Agent's conversations. This controls the panel's visibility, not the Agent's ability to edit files.

runtime_profile_name.label: Runtime runtime profile
runtime_profile_name.help: Select the saved runtime setup that provides the Agent program, sandbox settings, network access, and model connection. Credential Vaults are assigned separately.

exposure_mode.label: Available through
exposure_mode.help: Choose whether users can start conversations in the web app, through MCP, or both

idle_hibernate_seconds.label: Idle timeout (seconds)
idle_hibernate_seconds.help: After this many idle seconds, AstraBox applies the pause or removal behavior saved in the runtime runtime profile

prepared_capacity.label: Prepared capacity
prepared_capacity.help: How many new conversations can start at the same moment on a prepared runtime, from 0 to 1000. Each new conversation takes one prepared unit and AstraBox prepares a replacement within seconds; once all are taken, further conversations start cold until the capacity refills. When each conversation gets its own sandbox a unit is an idle sandbox; when conversations share the Agent's sandbox it is a prepared seat inside it. Every unit holds its resources while it waits. 0 turns prewarming off.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.help: When off, users cannot start a new conversation with this Agent

a2a_access.label: A2A access
a2a_access.help: Discover and message this user's existing conversations. This never grants access to another user's conversations.

a2a_agent_ids.label: Allowed Agents
a2a_agent_ids.help: The user's existing access to each target Agent still applies.
